scripts.build:firefox: vite build --outDir dist-firefox && node scripts/firefox-manifest.mjs dist-firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package.mjs firefox
scripts.build:safari: vite build --outDir dist-safari && SAFARI_ENTRY=background vite build --config vite.safari-scripts.config.ts && SAFARI_ENTRY=content vite build --config vite.safari-scripts.config.ts && node scripts/safari-manifest.mjs dist-safari
scripts.build:safari-app: npm run build:safari && node scripts/safari-app.mjs build
